subject: Shape deformation along RRPP predicted PC axes

messages.author: 544eca9c804a0347
messages.subject: Shape deformation along RRPP predicted PC axes
parts:
Dear colleagues,

to visualize shape changes across 12 treatments, I have been applying the lm.rrpp() function, and have predicted shape changes for each treatment using predict(). Now, I would like to know what shape deformation is represented by the first and second fitted PC axes. Running gm.prcomp on the same raw data (where it is easy to derive shape deformations from) yields a PCA of the variation within the sample, which clearly differs from the PC axes in the lm.rrpp() fit.

For this purpose, I need to either get a hold of the raw predicted values from the lm.rrpp() fit (predict() gives only the summarized values)) or a way to extract the dataset from the lm.rrpp() fit so I can conduct my "own" PCA in order to reveal the shape deformation. However, I find it difficult to do a way to do so  and would be glad if anyone could point me in the correct direction.

Thank you for your help!

Cheers
Bob
